entries.st: Maeto a phethilweng, direjistara tsa thupelo, ditshaeno, maikutlo, dinepe, ditemoho tsa serapa le dikarabo tsa ditlhahlobo di ka ema mona. Ho romela ho sebetsa ha app e butswe mme kgokahano e kgutla.
entries.ts: Maendzo lama hetiweke, tirhejistara ta ndzetelo, minsayino, mavonelo, swifaniso, leswi xiyixiweke exirhapeni ni tinhlamulo ta makambelelo swi nga rindza laha. Ku rhumela ku tirha loko app yi pfuriwile naswona vuhlanganisi byi vuyile.
entries.ve: Madalo o fhedzwaho, redzhisiṱara dza vhugudisi, tsaino, mahumbulwa, zwifanyiso, zwo vhonwaho ngadeni na phindulo dza ndingo zwi nga lindela hafha. U rumela hu shuma musi app yo vulea nahone vhuṱumani vhu tshi vhuya.

entries.english: For a conflict, keep a downloaded copy, remove this queued change, reconnect and reopen the current record. Compare the versions before saving your corrections. Permission or validation errors must be resolved before resubmitting.
entries.st: Ha diphetoho di thulana, boloka kopi e jarollotsweng, tlosa phetoho ena e emetseng ho romelwa, hokahana hape mme o bule rekoto ya hajwale hape. Bapisa mefuta eo pele o boloka ditokiso tsa hao. Diphoso tsa tumello kapa tsa ho netefatsa dintlha di lokela ho lokiswa pele o romela hape.
entries.ts: Loko ku cinca ku nga fambelani, hlayisa kopi leyi dawunilodiweke, susa ku cinca loku rindzeleke ku rhumeriwa, hlanganisa nakambe kutani u tlhela u pfula rhekhodo ya sweswi. Pimanisa tivhezheni u nga si hlayisa ku lulamisa ka wena. Swihoxo swa mpfumelelo kumbe swa ku tiyisisa vuxokoxoko swi fanele swi lulamisiwa ku nga si rhumeriwa nakambe.
entries.ve: Arali tshanduko dzi sa anḓani, vhulungani khophi yo dzhiwaho, bvisani tshanduko iyi yo lindelaho u rumelwa, ṱumanani hafhu ni dovhe ni vule rekhodo ya zwino. Vhambedzani zwivhumbeo izwo musi ni sa athu vhulunga ndulamiso dzaṋu. Vhukhakhi ha thendelo kana ha u khwaṱhisedza mafhungo vhu tea u lugiswa musi ni sa athu rumela hafhu.

entries.english: Local crop planning, journal notes and downloaded lessons can work without signal. AI chat, AI reports, transcription, receipt scanning, new sign-in and fresh online maps still need a connection. The map offers an Offline canvas for saved drawings and pins without satellite or terrain layers. Receipt originals in the money book remain on their original device.
entries.st: Ho rera dijalo sesebedisweng, dintlha tsa bukana le dithuto tse jarollotsweng di ka sebetsa ntle le kgokahano. Moqoqo wa AI, ditlaleho tsa AI, ho fetola puo e rekotilweng hore e be mongolo, ho skena dirasiti, ho kena akhaonteng botjha le dimmapa tse ntjha tsa inthanete di ntse di hloka kgokahano. Mmapa o fana ka sebaka sa ho taka ntle le kgokahano bakeng sa metako le diphini tse bolokilweng, ntle le disetshwantsho tsa sathelaete kapa dikarolo tsa sebopeho sa naha. Dirasiti tsa pele tse bukeng ya ditjhelete di sala sesebedisweng seo di qalileng ho sona.
entries.ts: Ku pulana swibyariwa eka xitirhisiwa, tinotsi ta jenali ni tidyondzo leti dawunilodiweke swi nga tirha handle ka vuhlanganisi. Mbulo wa AI, swiviko swa AI, ku hundzula rito leri rhekhodiweke ri va tsalwa, ku skena tirisiti, ku nghena eka akhawunti hi vuntshwa ni mimepe leyintshwa ya inthanete swa ha lava vuhlanganisi. Mepe wu nyika ndhawu yo dirowa handle ka vuhlanganisi ya swifaniso leswi dirowiweke ni tiphini leti hlayisiweke, handle ka swifaniso swa sathelayiti kumbe swiphemu swa xivumbeko xa misava. Tirisiti ta masungulo leti nga ebukwini ya mali ti sala eka xitirhisiwa lexi a ti ri eka xona eku sunguleni.
entries.ve: U pulana zwiliṅwa kha tshishumiswa, notsi dza dayari na ngudo dzo dzhiwaho zwi nga shuma hu si na vhuṱumani. Nyambedzano ya AI, mivhigo ya AI, u shandukisa ipfi ḽo rekhodiwaho ḽa vha maṅwalwa, u sikena rasithi, u dzhena kha akhaunthu nga huswa na mimapa miswa ya inthanethe zwi kha ḓi ṱoḓa vhuṱumani. Mapa u ṋea fhethu ha u ola hu si na vhuṱumani ha nyolo na phini dzo vhulungwaho, hu si na zwifanyiso zwa sathelaithi kana zwipiḓa zwa tshivhumbeo tsha mavu. Rasithi dza u thoma dzi re kha bugu ya masheleni dzi sala kha tshishumiswa tshadzo tsha u thoma.

entries.english: Use a normal browser window. Clearing site data removes downloads and unsent fieldwork. Keep this device protected, especially where it holds attendance signatures or photographs.
entries.st: Sebedisa fensetere e tlwaelehileng ya sebatli. Ho hlakola data ya sebaka sena ho tlosa tse jarollotsweng le mosebetsi wa tshimo o eso romelwe. Sireletsa sesebediswa sena, haholoholo haeba se na le ditshaeno tsa ba bileng teng kapa dinepe.
entries.ts: Tirhisa fasitere ra ntolovelo ra browser. Ku basisa data ya sayiti swi susa leswi dawunilodiweke ni ntiro wa le masin'wini lowu nga si rhumeriwaka. Sirhelela xitirhisiwa lexi, ngopfungopfu loko xi ri ni minsayino ya lava veke kona kumbe swifaniso.
entries.ve: Shumisani fasiṱere ḽa nḓowelo ḽa browser. U thutha data ya saithi zwi bvisa zwo dzhiwaho na mushumo wa masimuni u sa athu rumelwa. Tsireledzani tshishumiswa itshi, nga maanḓa arali tshi na tsaino dza vho ḓaho kana zwifanyiso.

entries.zu: Lolu hlelo lokuhumusha alukabuyekezwa. Hlola umbhalo wesiNgisi oseduze kwezenzo zokugcina, ukuthumela nokususa.

entries.ts: Vuhundzuluxi a byi si kamberiwa. Kambisisa tsalwa ra Xinghezi ekusuhi ni swiendlo swo hlayisa, ku rhumela ni ku susa.
entries.ve: Ṱhalutshedzo a i athu ṱolwa. Ṱolani maṅwalwa a English tsini na mishumo ya u vhulunga, u rumela na u bvisa.

entries.ts: A ku na vuhlanganisi
entries.ve: A hu na vhuṱumani

entries.english: Connection timed out. Your saved entry remains on this device.
entries.zu: Isikhathi sokuxhumana siphelile. Irekhodi lakho eligciniwe lisekhona kule divayisi.
entries.st: Nako ya kgokahano e fedile. Rekoto ya hao e bolokilweng e ntse e le sesebedisweng sena.
entries.ts: Nkarhi wa vuhlanganisi wu herile. Rhekhodo ya wena leyi hlayisiweke ya ha ri eka xitirhisiwa lexi.
entries.ve: Tshifhinga tsha vhuṱumani tsho fhela. Rekhodo yaṋu yo vhulungwaho i kha ḓi vha kha tshishumiswa itshi.

entries.english: This browser cannot save fieldwork on this device. Use a normal browser window.
entries.zu: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukugcina umsebenzi wasensimini kule divayisi. Sebenzisa iwindi elijwayelekile lesiphequluli.
entries.st: Sebatli sena ha se kgone ho boloka mosebetsi wa tshimo sesebedisweng sena. Sebedisa fensetere e tlwaelehileng ya sebatli.
entries.ts: Browser leyi a yi koti ku hlayisa ntiro wa le masin'wini eka xitirhisiwa lexi. Tirhisa fasitere ra ntolovelo ra browser.
entries.ve: Browser iyi a i koni u vhulunga mushumo wa masimuni kha tshishumiswa itshi. Shumisani fasiṱere ḽa nḓowelo ḽa browser.

entries.english: Close another ImbewuField tab and try saving again.
entries.zu: Vala enye ithebhu ye-ImbewuField bese uzama ukugcina futhi.
entries.st: Kwala tab e nngwe ya ImbewuField mme o leke ho boloka hape.
entries.ts: Pfala tab yin'wana ya ImbewuField kutani u ringeta ku hlayisa nakambe.
entries.ve: Valani iṅwe tab ya ImbewuField ni lingedze u vhulunga hafhu.

entries.english: The device could not save this entry. Keep the form open.
entries.zu: Idivayisi ayikwazanga ukugcina leli rekhodi. Gcina ifomu livuliwe.
entries.st: Sesebediswa ha se a kgona ho boloka rekoto ena. Boloka foromo e butswe.
entries.ts: Xitirhisiwa a xi kotanga ku hlayisa rhekhodo leyi. Tshika fomo yi pfuriwile.
entries.ve: Tshishumiswa a tsho ngo kona u vhulunga rekhodo iyi. Vhulungani fomo yo vulea.

entries.st: Polokelo ya sesebediswa ha e fumanehe.
entries.ts: Ndhawu yo hlayisa eka xitirhisiwa a yi kumeki.
entries.ve: Fhethu ha u vhulunga kha tshishumiswa a hu wanali.

entries.english: This request could not be completed.
entries.st: Kopo ena ha e a kgona ho phethwa.
entries.ts: Xikombelo lexi a xi kotanga ku hetisiwa.
entries.ve: Khumbelo iyi a yo ngo kona u fhedziswa.

entries.english: The server did not confirm this save.
entries.st: Seva ha e a tiisa poloko ena.
entries.ts: Sevha a yi tiyisisanga ku hlayisiwa loku.
entries.ve: Seva a yo ngo khwaṱhisedza u vhulungwa uhu.

entries.st: Ho emetswe kgokahano.
entries.ts: Ku rindzeriwa vuhlanganisi.
entries.ve: Hu lindelwa vhuṱumani.

sourceControls.english: Offline — using this device’s saved copies
sourceControls.zu: Awukho ku-inthanethi — usebenzisa amakhophi agcinwe kule divayisi

sourceControls.english: You are online — pages saved for offline use are listed below.
Prepare the pages and authorised records you need, including visit and training photos. This uses data and device storage. Stay signed in on this device.
sourceControls.zu: Lungiselela amakhasi namarekhodi agunyaziwe owadingayo, kuhlanganise nezithombe zokuvakasha nokuqeqesha. Lokhu kusebenzisa idatha nesikhala kule divayisi. Hlala ungenile kule divayisi.

sourceControls.english: Download lesson slides, narration and clips separately under
sourceControls.zu: Landa amaslayidi ezifundo, okulandiswayo neziqeshana ngokwehlukana ngaphansi kokuthi

sourceControls.english: Open your saved designs, crop plans and reports online once so their additional tools and images are available.
sourceControls.zu: Vula imiklamo, izinhlelo zezitshalo nemibiko yakho egciniwe kanye uxhumekile ukuze amathuluzi nezithombe ezengeziwe zitholakale.

sourceControls.english: These checks cover startup files. They do not promise fresh map imagery, every report image, or every optional tool.
sourceControls.zu: Lokhu kuhlola kuqinisekisa amafayela okuqalisa kuphela. Akuqinisekisi izithombe zemephu ezintsha, zonke izithombe zemibiko, noma wonke amathuluzi ongawakhetha.

sourceControls.english: Completed visits, training registers, signatures, feedback, photographs, garden observations and assessment responses can wait here. Sync runs when the app is open and a connection returns.
sourceControls.zu: Ukuvakasha okuqediwe, amarejista okuqeqesha, amasignesha, impendulo, izithombe, okubhekwe engadini nezimpendulo zokuhlola kungalinda lapha. Ukuvumelanisa kwenzeka uma uhlelo luvuliwe futhi uxhumano lubuya.

sourceControls.english: Nothing waiting to send. My Records saves separately.
sourceControls.zu: Akukho okufakiwe kulayini womsebenzi wasensimini. Incwadi yemali inesistimu yayo yokuvumelanisa.

sourceControls.english: Needs review — server save not confirmed
Saved on this device — waiting to send
Remove this device’s queued change? This cannot be undone here. Download a copy first if you need to keep it. The server record is not deleted.
sourceControls.zu: Susa ushintsho olulindile kule divayisi? Lokhu ngeke kuhlehliswe lapha. Landa ikhophi kuqala uma ufuna ukulugcina. Irekhodi elikuseva alisuswa.

sourceControls.english: For a conflict, keep a downloaded copy, remove this queued change, reconnect and reopen the current record. Compare the versions before saving your corrections. Permission or validation errors must be resolved before resubmitting.
sourceControls.zu: Uma kunokungqubuzana, gcina ikhophi elandiwe, susa lolu shintsho olulindile, xhuma futhi bese uvula irekhodi lamanje. Qhathanisa izinhlobo ngaphambi kokugcina izilungiso. Lungisa amaphutha emvume noma okuqinisekisa ngaphambi kokuthumela futhi.

sourceControls.english: {count} authorised information requests saved on this device. Their contents reflect the last successful download, plus your unsent changes.
sourceControls.zu: Izicelo zolwazi ezigunyaziwe ezingu-{count} zigcinwe kule divayisi. Ziqukethe ulwazi olwagcina ukulandwa ngempumelelo kanye nezinguquko zakho ezingakathunyelwa.

sourceControls.english: Local crop planning, journal notes and downloaded lessons can work without signal. AI chat, AI reports, transcription, receipt scanning, new sign-in and fresh online maps still need a connection. The map offers an Offline canvas for saved drawings and pins without satellite or terrain layers. Receipt originals in the money book remain on their original device.
sourceControls.zu: Ukuhlela izitshalo kule divayisi, amanothi ephephabhuku nezifundo ezilandiwe kungasebenza ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi. Ingxoxo ye-AI, imibiko ye-AI, ukubhala okushiwo, ukuskena amarisidi, ukungena okusha namamephu aku-inthanethi adinga uxhumano. Imephu inendawo engaxhunyiwe enemidwebo nezikhonkwane ezigciniwe, ngaphandle kwezendlalelo zesathelayithi nezendawo. Amarisidi okuqala encwadini yemali ahlala kule divayisi yawo.

sourceControls.english: Use a normal browser window. Clearing site data removes downloads and unsent fieldwork. Keep this device protected, especially where it holds attendance signatures or photographs.
sourceControls.zu: Sebenzisa iwindi lesiphequluli elivamile. Ukusula idatha yesayithi kususa okulandiwe nomsebenzi wasensimini ongakathunyelwa. Vikela le divayisi, ikakhulukazi uma igcina amasignesha okubakhona noma izithombe.

sourceControls.english: Preparation finished with gaps. Read the list below before leaving signal.
sourceControls.zu: Ukulungiselela kuqediwe kodwa kunezikhala. Funda uhlu olungezansi ngaphambi kokulahlekelwa yinethiwekhi.

sourceControls.english: Pages and available fieldwork records are saved on this device. Test reopening without signal before travelling.
sourceControls.zu: Amakhasi namarekhodi omsebenzi wasensimini atholakalayo agcinwe kule divayisi. Hlola ukuwavula ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi ngaphambi kohambo.

sourceControls.english: Finished sending. Anything still listed below is kept on this phone.
sourceControls.zu: Umzamo wokuvumelanisa uphelile. Okufakiwe okusaboniswe ngezansi kusese kule divayisi.

sourceControls.english: This browser cannot prepare the app for offline use.
sourceControls.zu: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukulungiselela uhlelo ukuthi lusebenze lungaxhunyiwe.

sourceControls.english: The app is still preparing its first offline start. Keep it open with a connection and try again.
sourceControls.zu: Uhlelo lusalungiselela ukuqalisa kokuqala lungaxhunyiwe. Lushiye luvuliwe luxhumekile bese uzama futhi.

sourceControls.english: Preparation timed out. Keep the app open with a connection and retry.
sourceControls.zu: Ukulungiselela kuthathe isikhathi eside kakhulu. Shiya uhlelo luvuliwe luxhumekile bese uzama futhi.

sourceControls.english: The workspace changed. Prepare again in the current account.
sourceControls.zu: Indawo yokusebenza ishintshile. Lungiselela futhi ku-akhawunti yamanje.

sourceControls.english: This entry is sending. Wait before removing it.
sourceControls.zu: Lokhu okufakiwe kuyathunyelwa. Linda ngaphambi kokukususa.

sourceControls.english: This service is not available for device saving.
sourceControls.zu: Le sevisi ayitholakali ukuze igcinwe kule divayisi.

sourceControls.english: Sign in and open your workspace before saving fieldwork on this device.
sourceControls.zu: Ngena bese uvula indawo yakho yokusebenza ngaphambi kokugcina umsebenzi wasensimini kule divayisi.

sourceControls.english: The account or organisation changed. Reopen your workspace.
sourceControls.zu: I-akhawunti noma inhlangano ishintshile. Vula kabusha indawo yakho yokusebenza.

scope: The 72 device/offline page controls, two short sync-badge labels, draft/source labels and eight additional exact errors from field-api, field-api-core, field-device-store and the service worker. Study pack/media controls are outside this batch.
notes: Original English UI and error sources remain exact. Existing isiZulu page wording remains exact except the absent connected sentence and two titles that retained the retired Offline & sync wording instead of Saved on this phone; their exact prior lines are recorded. The legacy bilingual draft-notice key remains unchanged.
Authorisation, account scopes, cache data, write bodies, operation IDs, leases, server acknowledgements, local-only removal and download bytes remain unchanged.
Known local error source strings are mapped exactly for display. Unknown server and user text is retained, never guessed or relabelled as reviewed.
Progress and error states retain language-independent identities; translation happens during rendering, including after changing language.

All four target languages retain English source disclosures next to save/send/remove guidance and separately tagged English on action controls. Source placeholders are filled using the actual counts/pages.

reasons.offlineTitle: The existing isiZulu title still expressed the retired Offline & sync name; align it with the current exact English source Saved on this phone.
reasons.offlinePageOffline: The readiness-list label names the same page; retain the same source meaning instead of the retired label.
